text: An operational review conducted in 2015 at the intersection of Kingston Road and Harewood Avenue, recommended that parking be prohibited on Kingston Road at the southwest corner of the above-noted intersection by removing one parking spot from the parking lay-by. It was recently identified by Transportation staff that the distance of the parking prohibition was excessive and resulted in the loss of four on-street parking spaces. To prevent the loss of four on-street parking spaces, staff recommends changing the existing stopping prohibition at all times on the south side of Kingston Road between Harewood Avenue and a point 36 metres west to 21 metres west.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Kingston Road, between a point 21 metres west of Harewood Avenue and a point 36 metres west of Harewood Avenue. 2. City Council authorize maximum one-hour parking at all times on the south side of Kingston Road, between a point 21 metres west of Harewood Avenue and a point 36 metres west of Harewood Avenue.
